context:
Goal: check cards in by name on the open Duo.
Problem (rule): the PR 144 mockup makes Card in Hand the Packages tab itself on the open Duo. The record duo-card-in-hand says Packages keeps its one-page layout. Those two disagree, and you haven't ruled either way.
Based on (read): the PR 144 mockup README, line 5.
Based on (read): record duo-card-in-hand, Defaults (a default, not your ruling).
Departs from: main's Packages tab opens the Packages list — option b makes it open Card in Hand on the open Duo.
Meanwhile: Duo builds option a. Switching to b later is a small change to the entry point.
